method: Bounded public-web review of public Ukrainian official Telegram previews. No authentication, platform API, access-control bypass, bulk capture, binary download, or precise operational-location retention was used.

sources_checked.result: Three primary in-window publications were retained: the 08:00 operational summary, the SAG-U/NSATU command-transfer statement, and the 22:00 operational summary. Granular frontline detail was omitted.
Three in-window aftermath updates were retained for Donetsk region, Dnipropetrovsk region, and Kyiv. District, facility, and attached-media detail was omitted.

excluded_candidates.source: General Staff air-attack update, Telegram message 41764
excluded_candidates.reason: The publication stated that the attack was still ongoing and included origin, direction, and impact-location detail; it was withheld under the operational-safety exclusion.

excluded_candidates.source: General Staff strike-target update published at 07:50 UTC
excluded_candidates.reason: The publication enumerated precise military targets, crossings, command points, and locations and was excluded as targeting-enabling detail.
The publication was in-window but outside the task topics of official war reporting, frontline reporting, and strikes.

artifact_capture.reason: No immutable permitted artifact was downloaded. Telegram previews did not provide stable content hashes or complete edit histories, and attached images or video were not copied.

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews do not provide API-grade completeness, stable content hashes, or complete edit history.
The scan retained only a bounded set of material primary publications and is not exhaustive across all Ukrainian official institutions.
Live air-attack and precise strike-target publications were withheld because their route, target, and active-status detail could be operationally sensitive.
DSNS casualty and damage figures remain attributable official statements and were not independently assessed in this discovery task.
The SAG-U/NSATU transfer post references US and NATO statements whose primary records were not separately collected in this shard.
No attached media was downloaded, hashed, or independently verified.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, active-unit locations, target coordinates, or named vulnerable facilities were persisted.
Granular frontline localities, active engagements, and emergency-response locations were omitted from excerpts and summaries.
No final truth assessment, territorial conclusion, source reliability score, or report narrative was created.
